column3: on the region of Anga (or: body part)
hair thrilled by contact with limbs, streams of tears
the Lord with limbs, minor limbs, weapons and ornaments, those four
with forearms laid on the shoulder
with the horn resting on the shoulder, blood
of those who do not listen to stories
of the things not to be done
free from fear from any side
of you two who do nothing
where the black antelope does not roam
the lord of those with eyes, by these two
rosary, small drum, skull, sword, bow
inexhaustible jewels, ornaments, weapons and so on
in the endless treasuries of inexhaustible jewels, ornaments and weapons, set an evil mind
Brahman-denoting, known by the three letters
of letters I am the letter A
by the slaying of a hundred akshauhinis
the purification by touch (of water), removing the sin of the whole world
the awakener of all powers of the moving and unmoving
with banks and waves of a river of deep water
... flows with the waves along the banks of deep-watered river
king of the cows of fire? (Agni and Rajagava)
the unintelligent body is like fire, like wood
the body is like fire, like wood
having turned to the Agnihotra cow
worshipping fire, sun, teacher, brahmana, and self
pure, worshipping fire, sun, teachers, cows, brahmanas, elders, gods
accompanied by worship of fire, sun, guests, cows, brahmanas, ancestors, gods
of fire, sun, water, poison and the like
only for the sake of fire
with the tip of the horn put forward
born of the limb (Angaja, Cupid); daughter
endowed with limbs and so on
of the size of a thumb-tip
of the blind who has no eyes
urged with elephants, chariots, horses and foot soldiers
urged with elephants, chariots, horses, foot soldiers, maces, swords, arrows, spears, javelins
of the non-thieves, sinless ones, up to the lowest born
of him unborn, of birth, preservation and dissolution
to the quality (guna) of the unborn, with birth, preservation, dissolution
even not knowing the virtue of the Self
blind with the darkness of pride in goats? (blinded by arrogance)
blind with the darkness of pride
not wishing to know my dharma
begot nine sons from the father
without offspring, without love for worldly objects
of the brilliance of crores of suns destroying the darkness of ignorance
covered in the sleep of ignorance
darkness of delusion and pride made by the cause of ignorance
the destroyer of the darkness of delusion and pride caused by ignorance
... he moves, praising, freed of qualities
anointing, rubbing, massage, and drawing of lines
in the herbs that are like atoms
to the smaller than the atom, of countless glory
they created the egg, my best abode
with a mind too dusty? (extremely defiled)
with very soft hands, feet, and wide chest
discontent from accumulation of wealth: these are the vaishya's natures
of the unsatisfied, with purpose unfulfilled
we were satisfied? (we are not satisfied)
other than this is to be thought by you
with extremely heavy rain and wind
doing exceedingly fierce and numerous deeds
wished for the child of Atri
Sumantu of the Atharva-Angirasa, the fierce
then attacked the great demon Agha
then the great demon Agha attacked them
and here also is this history
then rising from the southern fire place
then even the Unborn within the waters
then I, your enemy of myself, near you
then once upon a time the two sons
then thus though crest-jewel of all world-guardians
then from the ocean being churned
should take what is not given
gave, trembling with fear of the sea... (rose from the ocean)
of those entering with untamed cattle
shining with unfailing play, smiles and glances
polluted the fires with dung and urine
earache from the unseen shrilling cricket
became invisible, with bow and arrows taken up
became invisible, with eight weapons in arms, shining
invisible, with eight weapons, shining Kaustubha, priceless crown and earrings
because of not seen, not heard before
because of being not seen or heard thing
because of the unseen and unheard thing
with water, perfumes, unbroken rice, incense, clothes and garlands
today, the man-lion form of Hari
in the glow of the lip
below the sun, at ten thousand yojanas
pertaining to the gods, to the Self, to beings, thus
in the form of Adhiyajna (lord of sacrifice)
this indirect statement about the Self
the Self to the unwise here
those who speak of the Self
in the knowledge of the Self
on this path, knowing the great difficulty of wealth
born from the endless lotus feet
placed Death the ender on the lap
the abode of endless glory and qualities
rich in endless treasures and priceless costly furnishings
bereft of the beauty of no other man
whose sole refuge is single-minded devotion
by us, the imperishable, and those protected
with unwanted things looking like gain, of the ocean of constant bliss
whose wealth is not lost, remembering
of the two who see the non-self as self, O Lord
beings whose knowledge of the Self is lost by beginningless ignorance
those wearied by the toils of worldly existence, rooted in beginningless ignorance
because the cause has not ceased, again
whose vow is unfulfilled, to fire
by effortlessness, food got, own actions done
for grace Nara and Narayana appeared
and not yet risen, O king
day by day, this with reverence
those whose souls are sent after
freedom from waves (of hunger and thirst etc.)
not in the form of lordship
